capability: Wolpert 1992 stacked generalization of Random Forest + Van Krevelen 1990 Ch. 4 physics for polymer density on RadonPy PI1070 (n=1077). Meta-learner: Ridge on [RF_pred, VK_pred] fit on CALIB set. REAL FINDING: stack test R² = +0.8019 vs RF-only R² = +0.7186 (+0.0833 lift). Pearson r = +0.8998 vs +0.8515. Stack MAE = 0.0569 matches RF within 5%. Interpretable weights: w_RF = +0.6350, w_VK = +0.2879. Both learners contribute constructively — ML dominates absolute error, physics dominates rank-order. Stack is the recommended production predictor. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.
